name: Mushroom logs at sauna mist
notes:
Mushroom logs in the sauna mist: shiitake on fresh Blackbutt (trial beside Casuarina; eucalypt runs slower but fruits longer) plus native oyster or turkey tail from the PDC session.
Method: plug (dowel) logs – fresh untreated logs cut and rested 2–4 weeks, holes drilled in a diamond pattern, dowels hammered in, sealed with wax, each log tagged with species and date; or a totem stack of 30 cm rounds with grain spawn between.
Placement: shaded, in the mister overspray; roof drip is fine; logs off the ground on a base and above any flood reach.
Timing: inoculate in the cool months (Jun–Aug); spawn runs 6–18 months on hardwood; soak logs to trigger a flush.
Timber: use lopped and weed-tree wood (fresh, untreated) from the property.
After: spent logs go into hügel beds and compost.
Food rule: never eat a wild mushroom unless identified with certainty.
Source: PDC session 29 (mushroom inoculation) and Spa Guild notes.
